rules.name: Banish The Wicked
rules.description: The Dragonborn adds [YELLOW] to all Attacks performed against models of the Daedra, Undead, Vampire and Werewolf races.

rules.name: Banish The Wicked (Leveled)
rules.description: The Dragonborn adds [GREEN][YELLOW] to all Attacks performed against models of the Daedra, Undead, Vampire and Werewolf races.

rules.name: Sure-Footed
rules.description: The Dragonborn adds [YELLOW][YELLOW] to its Armor Rating against ranged attacks with the Force damage type.

rules.name: One With The Shadows (Leveled)
rules.description: The Dragonborn may restore 1 Stamina Point each time they start an activation with a Hidden token.

rules.name: Barbarian Strike (Leveled)
rules.description: When Vorstag scores a [CRITICAL HIT] for a melee attack, the attack immediately gains the Follow-Up keyword. Only one Follow-Up may be gained this way per weapon in a single round.

rules.name: Pack Master
rules.description: A party that includes Banning can include one more War Dog Familiar than is ordinarily allowed. In addition, friendly War Dogs within 3" gain the Bodyguard keyword, targeting Banning instead of the party Chamption

rules.name: Blade And Shadow
rules.description: All One-Handed weapons equipped by Jenassa gain the Lightweight keyword.

rules.name: Stubborn
rules.description: Mjoll adds [GREEN] to all Morale Checks.

rules.name: By Ysmir You'll Pay For That! (Leveled)
rules.description: Once per Round when Mjoll is damaged by a melee attack, as long as she is still standing she immediately performs a free melee attack against the [enemy] attacker, exactly as if she had spent a Ready token.

rules.name: Vampire Hunter
rules.description: The Dragonborn adds [GREEN] to all Attacks performed against Vampires and members of the Clan Volkihar Faction.

infoLinks.name: The Dragonborn: Champion of the Dawnguard (Leveled)

rules.name: Kindred Necromancer
rules.description: Each time Serana removes an enemy as a casualty within 6", she may take a Conjuration [Skill] Test. If the test is successful, place one [Revenant] in contact with Serana.  This is a friendly Summoned Creature - place the Upkeep Token on the [Reanimated Corpse]'s card. Serana cannot use this ability if she already has a Summoned Creature in play.

rules.name: Kindred Foe
rules.description: Serana automatically passes any Morale check she is required to take if there are any enemy Vampires in play.  However, members of the Clan Volkihar Faction add [GREEN] to their Melee Attacks if Serana is the target.

rules.name: Self-Sufficient
rules.description: Borgakh may perform a Special Action to restore 1 Health point.

rules.name: Alik'r Training
rules.description: Rayya adds [YELLOW] to Melee Attacks with an equipped Scimitar.

rules.name: Protective Instinct
rules.description: If this model Engages an enemy as a result of the Bodyguard special rule, it immediately performs a Melee Attack as a Free Action before the normal sequence of play resumes.

rules.name: Foretold
rules.description: Increase the range of Dragon Shouts (where applicable) by +2".

rules.name: Iron Hand
rules.description: This model's Unarmed Attacks add [YELLOW]. You may spend 1 Thu'um to add [BLACK] instead. In addition, for every 2 points of damage inflicted in Melee with an Unarmed Attack, this model restores 1 Stamina.

rules.name: Meditation
rules.description: As a Special Action, restore this model's Thu'um to maximum.

rules.name: A Hammer for Every Nail
rules.description: When performing a Melee Attack with an equipped Mace or Warhammer, the attack gains the Follow-Up (1) and Linebreaker Keywords.

rules.name: Combat Fury
rules.description: While this model is Engaged with two or more enemies, it adds [YELLOW] to its Melee Attack rolls and Armor Rating, and all of its Melee Attacks gain the Follow-Up Keyword.

rules.name: Winnow the Weak
rules.description: Each time this model removes an enemy with Strength 3 or less as a casualty, it may immediately restore 1 point in any Reserve.

infoLinks.name: The Dragonborn: Champion of Mehrunes Dagon (Leveled)

rules.name: Path of the Hunter
rules.description: The Dragonborn adds [GREEN][YELLOW] to all Attacks performed against models of the Beast or Monster type.

rules.name: Empower
rules.description: This model may choose to use Stamina points instead of Magicka when casting or Boosting Spells.

rules.name: Bloodsport
rules.description: When this model scores a Critical Hit in Melee, that attack gains the Bleed Keyword. However, if this model ever fails a Morale check, it immediately receives a Bleed Token.
